test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Identify the meaning of continentality.

options.text: Very hot during winters and very cold during summers
Very hot during summers and very cold during winters
Very hot during summers and lots of rain
Very cold during winters and not hot during summers

solution:
The correct answer is __**Very hot during summers and very cold during winters.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Continentality** refers to the **degree of temperature **variation within a landmass.
 
• Continentality is influenced by factors such as **latitude, altitude, ocean currents, and prevailing winds.**
 
• Continental climates are often found in the interior regions of large landmasses, such as **North America and Eurasia.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Polar climates** are found in regions near the Earth's poles, while** tropical wet climates** are found in regions near the equator.
 
• **Monsoon climates** are found in regions that experience seasonal winds, such as southern Asia and parts of Africa.
